This file carries part 1 of 9 of the array — rows 1–58134 of 518217 in rubric order; the 9 parts in file order are the full array. Rows omit a field whose value is the default: panelState defaults to “not a panel question.”, panelMember to false, owningFragmentId to null and moneyWeight to “standard”; non-default values are carried verbatim.
